svg.title: UX-10 engine states
svg.desc: Four engine states plus two transient states, each with a text label and a distinct shape. A second row shows the same chips in grayscale.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: UX-10 mockup 4 · Engine states without relying on color

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Each state has a word, a distinct shape and a different border or button label. The grayscale row is the same artwork with all color removed.

svg.text: Today (observed): the chip text is OFF, ON, THINKING, CRASHED with the same round dot, only the dot color changes. 'ON' does not say idle. A start failure (bad engine path) leaves the chip at OFF and the message only appears in the Engine Log tab.

text.font-family: Noto Sans, Cantarell, DejaVu Sans, sans-serif

svg.text: Proposal for a failed start: show the Disconnected state with the inline message in the strip, not only a log line. A crash already shows a dismissible red banner today.
